spans.s:
The feminine affix ति comes after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) युवन् and this affix gets the name तद्धित।

Terms: तद्धित
There is लुक् elision of the युवन् गोत्र (Patronymic) forming affix -- जीवति तु वंश्ये युवा

, when a प्राग्दीव्यतीय affix beginning with a vowel is to be added.

Terms: लुक्-गोत्र

The युवन् is optionally spoken of as गोत्र when contemptuous reference to him is intended.

Terms: युवन्
